mde_method: Condition on the observed discordance rate q; D follows Binomial(n,q); direction among discordants follows theta=(q+delta)/(2q); solve the minimum absolute paired difference with unconditional exact two-sided McNemar power at least 0.80.

retrieval_families.rrf_vs_bge_primary: reciprocal rank, Hit@1, Hit@10; Holm across three paired Wilcoxon tests
retrieval_families.rrf_vs_bge_binary_robustness: Hit@1 and Hit@10; Holm across two exact McNemar tests
retrieval_families.selective_enrichment: 75%, 50%, and 25% accepted-vs-abstained one-sided Fisher tests; Holm across three
